decision: Automated or systematic retrieval of NFL.com pages (injury report, game centre, transactions, reserve list)
options: (a) Request written consent from NFL Enterprises for systematic retrieval. (b) Licence an authorised data feed. (c) No systematic capture; keep single, owner-reviewed reads for verification only.
why_it_matters: NFL.com Terms (updated 16 May 2024) section 1.3 reads: 'Systematic retrieval of data or other content from the Services, whether to create or compile, directly or indirectly, a collection, compilation, database, or directory, is prohibited absent our express prior written consent.' https://www.nfl.com/legal/terms/

decision: Price-data policy: which price and game-result inputs may support published numbers
options: (a) Publish no ROI or correlation until a licensed opening and closing feed exists. (b) Publish ROI labelled as exploratory with provenance unconfirmed. (c) Acquire a licensed odds feed and capture prices before each kickoff.
default_if_no_answer: (a) Publish no ROI or correlation until a licensed opening and closing feed exists
why_it_matters: No opening price exists in any source, and the input file's licence and provenance are unknown (origination/flagged.html, OD-01 and OD-02).

decision: Joint-evidence gate for combos: what to do with X-PARLAY and any other combo
options: (a) Remove X-PARLAY from the ranked table now, as the brief's gate requires. (b) Keep it visible but marked not rankable. (c) Validate a joint probability from paired outcomes, then rank.
default_if_no_answer: (a) Remove X-PARLAY from the ranked table now
why_it_matters: X-PARLAY is priced with rho = 0, which is the independence product of the legs, and it is shown with the best ROI in the desk (RV-01).

decision: Pre-registration protocol: how results are separated from design
options: (a) Label every current strategy exploratory, then register each new rule in a commit before its window opens. (b) Re-run all strategies on a sealed season before any claim. (c) Continue as now (not recommended).
default_if_no_answer: (a) Label current strategies exploratory and register future rules before their windows
why_it_matters: The strategy definitions and their results were committed together, so no registration preceded any result (RV-02).

decision: Storage split: where row-level raw data lives
options: (a) Move raw row-level files to a private store and publish only derived values. (b) Keep them public and mark the licence as unknown. (c) Keep the public tree as it is.
default_if_no_answer: (a) Move raw row-level files to a private store and publish only derived values
why_it_matters: Row-level raw files are in the public repository while their provenance is unknown (RV-04).

options: (a) Verify official per-club depth-chart pages for all 32 clubs, club by club. (b) Derive depth from an official snap-count source. Build the backup feature only after one route is verified for all 32 clubs.
default_if_no_answer: (a) Verify route (a) club by club, if DEC-01 permits the page retrieval
why_it_matters: Every chart in the repo is labelled unofficial, and 0 of 32 clubs are verified (RV-05).

options: (a) Obtain an authorised structured source for the Texans chart from the club. (b) Leave the Texans chart blank and flagged. Packers: strip jersey numbers and store the raw string.
default_if_no_answer: (b) Leave the Texans chart blank and flagged
why_it_matters: Transcribing an image by eye is not an acceptable source.

options: (a) Official link for every external fact; a repository artefact link only for internal facts. (b) Repository links for all rows, with official links where they exist.
